about: A 52-year-old man receives on-demand Priligy during a course of Efexor-XR, with both medicines recorded by brand only.
Venlafaxine starts eight days after the last fluoxetine dose, with the last fluoxetine supply 22 days before venlafaxine.
The last sertraline supply and first venlafaxine supply are 36 days apart, but the recorded last sertraline dose precedes the venlafaxine start.
